name: app-shater-offers-and-orders-screens-grid-with-60-screen-banner
title: Shater offers, wallet and support screens grid ending in a '+60 Screen' orange banner
whatItIs: A 4x5 grid of Arabic phone screens covering submitting and editing offers, order details, a wallet with balance and withdrawal, a craftsman profile with ratings, invoice details and support tickets with chat, closing in a bold orange '+60 Screen' banner.
whatItMeans: Exhaustive and credible; wallet and support screens show the platform handles money and problems, not just bookings.
techniques: Include financial and support screens, not just the happy path.
End every grid with a scale-proving banner.

vocabulary.definition: A UI showing balance and withdrawal options.
